instruction: Clean studio portrait photography, medium close-up at eye level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige background, the blonde woman in the light green blazer (R1) sits on the left, her torso angled right. She looks directly at the dark-haired woman in the white blazer (R2), who sits on the right, facing left. The two women sit close together, sharing a quiet, intimate gaze with neutral expressions. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates them, highlighting the pastel palette of sage green, white, and beige.
